stories.title: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins
stories.summary: An ongoing phishing campaign dubbed "GoodGuys" impersonates major brands, including Google, Nvidia, Accenture, and SpaceX, to steal corporate Google and Okta credentials using fake invitations to paid expert interviews and webinars.

stories.title: Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension
